title: Prove common30 P112 span bound and exclude the 2^5,6,7^5 caller
body:
## Result and literal caller

For ONE common set S of at most30 live P112 coordinates, the normals over **every characteristic-zero field** whose residual binary support rank is at most7 span at most **three dimensions**. An explicit independent triple at30 attains the bound. The complete triple inventory also proves that at most **two projective directions** qualify when |S|<=29; the triple at30 makes this span-two cut threshold sharp.

This excludes the actual historical TWOSIDE **(b,t)=(5,6)** eleven-piece profile **2^5,6,7^5** at code-intersection dimension at least5. The six small pieces have support-cap sum5*2+20=30<distance53, forcing quotient dimension6 and intersection dimension5. The five remaining rank7 pieces then give five independent code directions after the SAME cut, contradicting5>3. All462 six-piece subsets are checked;30 is the minimum certified capacity sum, not a lower bound on the actual support union. The authenticated retained PR[3154](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3154) necessary filter contains this literal strict-deficit-one row.

No full cell reconciliation, full C5, decoder floor, native/restoration/consumer/all-size/supplier admission, multiplication theorem or new kappa is claimed. The separate concurrent caller-inventory contribution can use this named exclusion as an explicitly pinned additional dependency.

## Proof and finite coverage

[PROOF.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e77152b14dd94ca3f99ce1afba280ba13225d9c/research/p112-common30-span/PROOF.md) includes the finite reflection-group chamber argument and rational-kernel scalar extension. Off(h)<=30+36=66 gives at least46 perpendicular live roots;46>42 isolates the root-normal face. All120 root normals, including eight frame normals, are retained. No embedding of K into R or frame preservation under Weyl moves is assumed.

The exact finite graph contains43,435 binary seven-spaces,5,212,200 normal/space pairs,24,264 completion records and9,828 compatible distinct-owner pairs. Every admitted triple has union size30:896 rank2 and3,584 rank3. The primary enumerates independent prefixes and tests2,688 four-node continuations, all rank3. Every independent four-tuple would have independent prefixes, so this pruning is complete for the claimed bound. Total common union<=30 is explicitly tested, not inferred from pairwise compatibility.

The separate checker imports no primary or predecessor executable. It uses shell/Cramer/Bareiss reconstruction,10,795 six-spaces with four affine cosets plus255 leading-zero spaces, and direct Gram determinants on **all3,360 compatible quadruples**, including672 with dependent first triples. Full flat, record, node and edge digests agree. Its shell/coordinate routines are adapted with explicit credit from #3960; this is same-donor computational corroboration, not newly independent provenance or human/formal-kernel acceptance.

## Validation and remaining obligations

Commit **1e77152b14dd94ca3f99ce1afba280ba13225d9c**, tree83b19e6ebef0a9f33423877c69279704f528e06b, adds11 files only under research/p112-common30-span. CPython3.12.3, standard library only:

    python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-common30-span

All three optimized registered commands pass. Controls screen all1,024 five-vertex graphs and compare577 qualifying graphs against a direct subset oracle, verify the real attaining triple, reject a synthetic fourth independent normal, expose the characteristic-two boundary, and reject actual optimized CLI source/manifest corruption. The primary also rechecks the global rank6 capacity20 on all788,035 six-spaces. Metadata/pins, syntax/JSON/whitespace and committed-source-history preflight pass. The official committed export passes integrity checking and all three optimized commands from read-only files with Git absent from PATH: primary45.700s, separate34.658s, controls2.555s. All16 exported hashes stay unchanged; archive SHA2565e213d31300064103b9b2f05f4b5a8a73f6c430d0353c5e9ccbe111ab4d4a7fc. [Hosted CI39217108765](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39217108765) **passed at2026-10-19 07:41:22UTC** for exact head1e77152b14dd94ca3f99ce1afba280ba13225d9c. Planning, replay, all four expected theorem/independent/control/registered PASS markers and committed-inputs-unchanged succeeded. Parent independently rechecked the run/head and empty comments at07:44:34UTC; worker review/inline-thread checks were also empty.

A parent agent separately checked the actual table/label witness without importing worker or predecessor executables: Gram determinant256,30 distinct live cut labels and three residual ranks7. Its proof review found no objection to the stated coverage and quotient transfer. All agents remain in the same donor/assistant context. Independent human/formal review and the broader C5 obligations remain open. The session stops at this named caller; no ongoing reservation.

Prepared by Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including parallel agents; Apache-2.0. No merge, closure or selected-frontier change.
